body:
Making amazing videos is only part of the equation. If you want your content seen and liked, shared and clicked, you have to find a way to be part of what everyone else is already looking at.

Sometimes, the timing is everything when it comes to a video that takes off as opposed to one that's lost in oblivion. SMMGen brings you a clear, easy-to-follow breakdown of the best days and times to post on YouTube in the USA. We'll also help you learn how to find the best schedule for your specific audience.

## Why Posting Time Matters on YouTube

When you upload a video, the first few hours are the most important. This is what YouTube takes into account: how people engage with your content. The faster people are responding to your video (watching, liking, and commenting), the more likely YouTube is to promote it to others.

Sharing at the correct time will mean more people see your video when it's new. It makes it more likely that you will get new subscribers and that your content will perform better over the long run.

## Best Days to Post on YouTube in the USA

Not all days are equal when it comes to YouTube engagement. Viewers tend to be more active on certain days, especially when they have more free time. Here's a breakdown of what works best in the United States:

### Thursday and Friday

Many YouTubers see high engagement these days. They begin to relax and free up more time in the evening. Videos posted on Thursday or Friday also tend to continue to rack up views over the weekend.

### Saturday and Sunday

The morning or early afternoon, when relaxed viewers are home and cruising YouTube. Your video will have more hours to accumulate views before evening if you post in the earlier part of the day.

### Wednesday

If something comes to you on Wednesday, uploading then can work well, particularly in the afternoon. If you are presenting to professionals or people in college, this can be a nice option.

### Monday and Tuesday

These are the slowest days for engagement. People are often busy catching up on work or school. Unless your analytics show otherwise, it's better to avoid these days.

## Best Times to Post on YouTube

Most users in the USA are active on YouTube during the evening. However, that doesn't mean you should post at 8 PM. If you do, your video will get lost along with many other videos that were uploaded at the same time.

The smarter strategy is to share 1–2 hours before you reach the peak. This will allow YouTube to process your video and start surfacing it in Recommended before most people's feed fills up with new vids.

### Best Posting Times in Eastern Time (EST)

- **Weekdays:** Between 2 PM and 4 PM
- **Weekends:** Between 9 AM and 11 AM

### Understanding USA Time Zones

The United States spans four primary time zones: Western, Mountain, Central, and Eastern. Countries and cities in Eastern and Central zones East and Central zones are populated areas.

A 3 PM EST upload goes live at:

- 2 PM Central
- 1 PM Mountain
- Noon Pacific

## When Should You Post YouTube Shorts?

YouTube Shorts are brief video clips that act in much the same way as TikTok or Instagram Reels. They clog vertical feeds and can go viral quickly if you post them at the right time.

### Best Times for Shorts:

- **12 PM to 2 PM:** Lunch hour browsing
- **8 PM to 10 PM:** Evening scroll time

## How to Find the Right Time for Your Channel

![](https://smmgen-backend.fexpink.com/storage/media/1/q6l29oauw9t78ujk.jpg)

YouTube channels come with slightly different sets of readers. What works for one creator won't work for everyone. According to SMMGen, the following is what you should do to determine what would be most effective for you:

### 1. Check YouTube Analytics

Inside YouTube Studio, go to the "Audience" tab. Look for the section called "When your viewers are on YouTube." This shows you the exact days and hours your viewers are most active.

### 2. Analyze Your Top Videos

Take note of the upload times of your most successful videos. If several of them were posted at similar hours or days, that's a strong signal.

### 3. Test Different Posting Times

Try uploading at different times over a few weeks. Use the same style and length of content so you can track results fairly. Watch for patterns in views, likes, and watch time.

### 4. Know Your Audience

Think about who your audience is and how their day looks.

- Are they students? Post after school.
- Are they working professionals? Post after 5 PM.
- Are they parents? Mornings may work better.

## Final Thoughts

The best time to post on YouTube for most US audiences is:

- 2 PM to 4 PM on weekdays
- 9 AM to 11 AM on weekends

Thursday to Sunday are the top days for the most engagement with your content, assuming it is entertaining, informative, or personal growth related.
